scenes.vo: Last night, something covered my peephole from the other side.
In the morning, I stepped into the hall. Around the peephole was a greasy smudge. Above my door were long finger marks. HIGHER than any person could reach.
I went down to the basement office. The landlady, Mrs. Dorsey, didn't look surprised. She just kept knitting.
It knocked, didn't it? she said. Three times, at three. Did you ANSWER it?
I remembered whispering through the door that first night. I don't know why, but I looked her in the eye and said no.
She put her needles down and stared at me for a long time. Then she asked, Did it say your NAME yet?
